directives.name: b-data
directives.description: Create a nested state scope from an object expression. Read it as `$data`.

directives.name: b-provide
directives.description: Provide live named values to this element and its subtree through `$provided`.

directives.name: b-id
directives.description: Generate named unique values in `$id`; bind them to `id`, `for`, or ARIA attributes explicitly.

directives.name: b-ref
directives.description: Register this element under a literal name in the local, read-only `$ref` registry.

directives.name: b-text
directives.description: Reactively set the element's text content. Safe for user-provided text.

directives.name: b-html
directives.description: Insert markup without activating Brio. Does not sanitize: never pass untrusted HTML.

modifiers.name: hydrate
modifiers.description: Activate Brio directives in templates marked with `trustedHTML()`.

directives.name: b-bind-*
directives.description: Reactively bind a DOM attribute or property, including on component hosts. Use b-prop-* or b-props for component inputs. `class` accepts strings, arrays, or objects; `style` accepts strings or objects.

modifiers.name: prop
modifiers.description: Set the DOM property instead of the attribute.

suggestions.name: class
suggestions.description: Classes from a string, array, or `{ name: condition }` object.

suggestions.name: style
suggestions.description: Styles from a string or `{ property: value }` object.

suggestions.name: id
suggestions.description: Element id (pair with `$id` for unique ids).

directives.name: b-on-*
directives.description: Listen for a DOM event and run a statement. `$event` is the event, e.g. `b-on-submit.prevent="$data.save($event)"`.

modifiers.name: prevent
modifiers.description: Call `event.preventDefault()`.

modifiers.name: stop
modifiers.description: Call `event.stopPropagation()`.

modifiers.name: self
modifiers.description: Run only when the event targets this element itself.

modifiers.name: outside
modifiers.description: Run only for events outside this element (ignores the event that created it).

modifiers.name: window
modifiers.description: Listen on `window`.

modifiers.name: document
modifiers.description: Listen on `document`.

modifiers.name: debounce
modifiers.description: Wait until events pause for 150ms (or the `.options` delay), then run once.

modifiers.name: throttle
modifiers.description: Run at most once every 150ms (or the `.options` delay).

modifiers.name: capture
modifiers.description: Use a capturing listener.

modifiers.name: passive
modifiers.description: Use a passive listener (cannot call `preventDefault()`).

modifiers.name: once
modifiers.description: Remove the listener after the first event that passes the other filters.

modifiers.name: ctrl
modifiers.description: Run only while Ctrl is held.

modifiers.name: alt
modifiers.description: Run only while Alt is held.

modifiers.name: shift
modifiers.description: Run only while Shift is held.

modifiers.name: meta
modifiers.description: Run only while Meta is held.

modifiers.name: enter
modifiers.description: Run only when Enter is pressed.

modifiers.name: esc
modifiers.description: Run only when Escape is pressed.

modifiers.name: space
modifiers.description: Run only when Space is pressed.

modifiers.name: tab
modifiers.description: Run only when Tab is pressed.

modifiers.name: up
modifiers.description: Run only when ArrowUp is pressed.

modifiers.name: down
modifiers.description: Run only when ArrowDown is pressed.

modifiers.name: left
modifiers.description: Run only when ArrowLeft is pressed.

modifiers.name: right
modifiers.description: Run only when ArrowRight is pressed.

modifiers.name: delete
modifiers.description: Run only when Delete or Backspace is pressed.

suggestions.name: click
suggestions.description: A pointer click or keyboard activation.

suggestions.name: input
suggestions.description: A control's value changed while typing.

suggestions.name: submit
suggestions.description: A form was submitted; usually paired with `.prevent`.

suggestions.name: keydown
suggestions.description: A key was pressed; combine with key modifiers like `.enter`.

suggestions.name: focusin
suggestions.description: Focus moved into the element or a descendant.

suggestions.name: focusout
suggestions.description: Focus moved out of the element or a descendant.

suggestions.name: scroll
suggestions.description: The element or window scrolled; consider `.throttle` or `.passive`.

suggestions.name: toggle
suggestions.description: A `<details>` or popover opened or closed.

directives.name: b-model
directives.description: Two-way bind a text-like input, textarea, checkbox, radio, or select to state.

modifiers.name: lazy
modifiers.description: Update on `change` instead of every `input`.

modifiers.name: trim
modifiers.description: Trim whitespace from the written value.

modifiers.name: number
modifiers.description: Write `parseFloat(value)`, keeping nonnumeric text unchanged.

directives.name: b-if
directives.description: Render this branch while the expression is truthy. Inactive branches are removed by default.

modifiers.name: hide
modifiers.description: Keep inactive branches in the DOM, hidden, preserving local state.

modifiers.name: detach
modifiers.description: Keep inactive branches alive outside the DOM, preserving local state.

directives.name: b-else-if
directives.description: Render when every previous sibling branch is false and this expression is truthy.

directives.name: b-else
directives.description: Render when every previous sibling branch is false.

directives.name: b-for
directives.description: Repeat the element for an array, iterable, object, or integer. Read the item as `$for.<name>`.

directives.name: b-key
directives.description: Give a repeated item a stable string or number identity. Used with `b-for`.

directives.name: b-template
directives.description: Render this element's contents in place without a wrapper. Implied on a `<template>` that carries any `b-` directive.

directives.name: b-teleport
directives.description: Move this element or template range next to an Element, ref, or selector. Default placement: `after`.

directives.name: b-transition
directives.description: Animate enter and leave with named CSS transition classes.

directives.name: b-effect
directives.description: Run a reactive expression for side effects; it reruns when what it reads changes.

directives.name: b-script
directives.description: Mark a `<script>` whose body is an unassigned arrow function. Brio calls it with `$context`; cleanup belongs to that piece of HTML.

directives.name: b-mask
directives.description: Format an input with a pattern string or a synchronous formatter function. Requires the inputs add-on (`brio.inputs.min.js` or `inputsPlugin` from `@jnreis/briojs/inputs`).

directives.name: b-form
directives.description: Track a form's values, validation errors, touched fields, and submission as `$form`. Requires the inputs add-on (`brio.inputs.min.js` or `inputsPlugin` from `@jnreis/briojs/inputs`).

directives.name: b-ignore
directives.description: Skip hydration for this element and its descendants.

directives.name: b-cloak
directives.description: Removed when Brio hydrates the element. Pair with `[b-cloak] { display: none; }`.

directives.name: b-router-outlet
directives.description: Render the component matching the current route. Requires a router (`createApp({ router })`).

directives.name: b-on-enter
directives.description: Run when the element enters the viewport (or `root`). `$entry` is the intersection entry. Requires the observers add-on.

modifiers.name: once
modifiers.description: Stop after the first callback.

modifiers.name: debounce
modifiers.description: Debounce callbacks by 100ms, or by the `debounce` option.

options.name: root
options.description: Element, selector, or null for the viewport.

options.name: rootMargin
options.description: CSS margin around the root, such as `'200px'`.

directives.name: b-on-exit
directives.description: Run when the element leaves the viewport (or `root`). `$entry` is the intersection entry. Requires the observers add-on.

modifiers.name: once
modifiers.description: Stop after the first callback.

modifiers.name: debounce
modifiers.description: Debounce callbacks by 100ms, or by the `debounce` option.

options.name: root
options.description: Element, selector, or null for the viewport.

options.name: rootMargin
options.description: CSS margin around the root, such as `'200px'`.

directives.name: b-on-addednodes
directives.description: Run when child nodes are added. `$mutations` lists the records. Requires the observers add-on.

options.name: target
options.description: Element, document, text node, or selector to observe instead of this element.

modifiers.name: debounce
modifiers.description: Debounce callbacks by 100ms, or by the `debounce` option.

modifiers.name: subtree
modifiers.description: Observe descendants too (the default unless the options set `subtree: false`).

directives.name: b-on-removednodes
directives.description: Run when child nodes are removed. `$mutations` lists the records. Requires the observers add-on.

options.name: target
options.description: Element, document, text node, or selector to observe instead of this element.

modifiers.name: debounce
modifiers.description: Debounce callbacks by 100ms, or by the `debounce` option.

modifiers.name: subtree
modifiers.description: Observe descendants too (the default unless the options set `subtree: false`).

directives.name: b-on-attrs
directives.description: Run when attributes change. `$mutations` lists the records. Requires the observers add-on.

options.name: target
options.description: Element, document, text node, or selector to observe instead of this element.

modifiers.name: debounce
modifiers.description: Debounce callbacks by 100ms, or by the `debounce` option.

modifiers.name: subtree
modifiers.description: Observe descendants too (the default unless the options set `subtree: false`).

directives.name: b-on-text
directives.description: Run when text (character data) changes. `$mutations` lists the records. Requires the observers add-on.

options.name: target
options.description: Element, document, text node, or selector to observe instead of this element.

modifiers.name: debounce
modifiers.description: Debounce callbacks by 100ms, or by the `debounce` option.

modifiers.name: subtree
modifiers.description: Observe descendants too (the default unless the options set `subtree: false`).

directives.name: b-on-resize
directives.description: Run when the element (or document with `.document`) changes size. Read `$size.width` and `$size.height`. Requires the observers add-on.

modifiers.name: debounce
modifiers.description: Debounce callbacks by 100ms, or by the `debounce` option.

modifiers.name: document
modifiers.description: Observe the document element instead.

directives.name: b-prop-*
directives.description: Pass a named reactive component prop through `$props`. Does not bind the host DOM.

directives.name: b-slot
directives.description: Expose a reactive object as $slot to parent-authored content in a component slot outlet. Slot names remain literal.

directives.name: b-props
directives.description: Spread a reactive object into component props. Own enumerable keys override named and static props; removed keys reveal lower-priority values.

directives.name: b-app
directives.description: Astro adapter: mark an island root by its registered app name.

directives.name: b-app-props
directives.description: Astro adapter: a trusted expression evaluated once and passed to the island's app factory.
